prompt:
Write a CommonJS JavaScript module. Export exactly the requested function with module.exports = functionName. Use no imports, dependencies, filesystem or network. Return only one fenced javascript code block, with no explanation.

Implement parseCsvRow(row), returning string cells for one CSV row. Commas delimit cells. A cell beginning with a double quote is quoted; doubled quotes inside it represent one quote. A closing quote must be followed by a comma or end of row. Quotes in an unquoted cell, unclosed quotes, characters after a closing quote, or any CR/LF are invalid: throw Error. Preserve empty cells and spaces. Empty input returns [""].
